carnivore.definition: An animal that eats other animals. Carnivores are often the strong, heavy ones.
carnivore.example: The heavy animal with the thick tail was a carnivore.

could_i.definition: A softer way to ask, good for when you talk to somebody you do not know well.
could_i.example: Could I have the menu, please?

mon_central_bank.definition: The public body with the right to issue the currency of a country.
mon_central_bank.example: The central bank raises its interest rate when prices rise too fast.

notebook.definition: A book of blank pages you write in at school.
notebook.example: I write my homework in a notebook.
